The founding belief

“Your home holds the life you’re building.”

That belief is where PalmHaus began. Iskra Araujo shared the founding story on 14 November 2026, four days after she announced her own brokerage to the people who follow her work.

PalmHaus is deliberately small. A boutique brokerage in South Miami, built around one broker who knows the ground she covers and the people she serves.

Buying a home

For buyers across Miami-Dade and Broward, with plain guidance at every step. Iskra explains the parts nobody warns you about, including what to know about property taxes after you buy in Miami-Dade or Broward.

Selling a home

Selling the home where your life has been happening deserves a broker who treats it that way. PalmHaus sells homes across Miami, led personally by its broker owner.
